headline: Development builds gain reflections as co-op shares equipment and planets
summary: OpenRAC development gains environment reflections, editor controls and fixes for drones, menus and co-op figures. Multiplayer releases bring shared equipment, gold bolts and planets, smoother remote movement and Android builds. The stable v0.10.0 release remains a proposal in OpenRAC#116. Going Commando reaches 65.83% matched code by size on USA v1.01, where matching means compiled C reproduces the original game's bytes. Deadlocked gains US and PAL matches, Up Your Arsenal adds NTSC-U frontend routines, and Ratchet & Clank has an unmerged readability proposal.
